For a 50-person Indian company, these are purchase-ready options to request quotes for now:

Provider/product	Current price	Important limitations
FCM Travel / FCM Platform	Quote-only; no public India tariff	Pricing depends on booking mix and service model; verify transaction, implementation and 24/7-service fees. FCM offers India support, policy management, payments and traveller safety. 
FCM Travel
+1

BCD Travel	Quote-only	Ask specifically about management fees, online-booking/PNR fees and pass-through technology costs. BCD has India offices including Bengaluru. 
BCD Travel
+1

Amex GBT / Egencia	Quote-only	Pricing is customised; some payment products have separate fees. Amex's India Business Travel Account can consolidate air spend and offers up to ₹30 lakh accident cover, subject to terms. 
Egencia
+1

What to demand in each quote: ₹/booking, annual platform fee, implementation fee, after-hours support, cancellation/reissue charges, GST, and minimum commitment. None of these providers currently publishes a reliable all-in ₹/employee price for a 50-person Indian programme. 
Egencia
+1
